notes: Step 2 licenses two materially different outcomes: change the product behavior, or change the expectation that describes it. Nothing in the flow or the input chooses between them. usw-run-flow requires decision_required when the text admits materially different next actions, so silently picking a branch is the failure. This scenario first observed 2/3: one run reported blocked, because blocked was listed among the allowed statuses and defined nowhere, leaving a model that cannot proceed without a human choice free to report either. After usw-run-flow defined the distinction by who can lift the stop, the same runner observed 3/3. Keep status_in strict: it is now a test of that distinction rather than of an undefined word.
